build.reason: CMake creates the fuzz executable only when LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE is defined. The recipe does not establish that environment value, and no build result is supplied.

input.reason: A finite byte input can contain nonempty OBJ text, a NUL separator and MTL text. The entry copies both spans into strings, and ParseFromString passes them as streams to LoadObj.

lifecycle.reason: The reader, configuration and input strings remain local while the synchronous ParseFromString call constructs streams and completes LoadObj before returning.

control_flow.reason: The entry-to-LoadObj route is supplied, but ObjReaderConfig defaults and the complete changed vertex helper are not. Those facts determine the configured parser route and the vertex forms accepted on it.

missing_information: The complete tinyobj::parseVertexWithColor body is needed to resolve g0020 and g0032.
The tinyobj::ObjReaderConfig declaration and defaults are needed to establish the configured parser route.
The static build environment must establish whether LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE is defined for the supplied recipe.
